project_info.theme: Extreme fisheye rooftop streetwear portrait with a dominant red-soled sneaker
project_info.creative_direction: Energetic urban fashion image using forced perspective and dramatic low-angle distortion
project_info.color_palette: bright red, white, black, clear sky blue, silver-gray concrete, and reflective glass

main_subject.detail: adult woman with shoulder-length brown hair and a confident relaxed expression looking down toward the camera
main_subject.wardrobe: bright red track jacket with white sleeve stripes, bright red fitted leggings, and massive white chunky platform sneakers with a distinct red tread pattern
main_subject.action: sitting casually on the corner of a modern minimalist ledge with one leg extended toward the lens

composition_elements.framing: close-up full-body vertical composition from an extreme low angle, with the extended sneaker as the dominant foreground element
composition_elements.environment: urban rooftop or high vantage point surrounded by curved glass skyscrapers and sleek modern architecture
composition_elements.perspective: strong forced perspective and fisheye distortion, with sharp focus from the shoe sole to the skyline
composition_elements.background: clear blue sky, clean modern ledge, and no crowd

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: hard midday sunlight at approximately 5600K with a small frontal bounce
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: sunburst and lens flare in the upper left, high-contrast shadows on concrete and glass, vivid red wardrobe, and crisp sneaker texture

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame camera with 8mm fisheye lens, extreme worm's-eye perspective, high-resolution fashion photography
technical_specs.finish: realistic leather and concrete texture, deep depth of field, slight barrel distortion, natural vignetting, and restrained saturation

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an energetic urban streetwear fashion photograph of a clearly adult woman with shoulder-length brown hair sitting casually on the corner of a modern minimalist rooftop ledge, looking down at the camera with a confident, relaxed expression. One leg extends toward the lens in extreme foreshortening, making a massive white chunky platform sneaker with a distinct red tread pattern the dominant foreground element. She wears a bright red track jacket with white stripes on the sleeves and bright red fitted leggings. Surround her with towering curved glass skyscrapers and sleek modern architecture. Use bright daylight, hard approximately 5600K sunlight, a sunburst and lens flare in the upper left, high-contrast shadows, an 8mm fisheye lens, extreme worm's-eye perspective, deep depth of field, realistic material texture, slight barrel distortion, and vivid but controlled color.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, unsafe ledge, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, broken shoe anatomy, melted architecture
